text_block_list.text:
Hm-hmm~♪ The weather's great today too, 
perfect for a walk~♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Lightning!? Even though it's sunny 
outside...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, I might get a little hyped up~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Got it! ...Though the tree ended up in a 
shadow due to the backlight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft became completely obsessed 
with taking photos of lightning, ending up 
skipping her training.
